title: [PS5] Final Fantasy Resonance $69 + $10 Delivery (Free Pick Up in Store) @ Big W
body:
Deal: [PS5] Final Fantasy Resonance $69 + $10 Delivery (Free Pick Up in Store) @ Big W

[mangobango] Same price on switch and switch 2, I ended up price matching at JB and using a perks voucher (they didn't let me do both in-store but it works on the live chat price match).
[Nashie069] Enjoying the game. Initially thought the resonance system was a gimmick but adds depth to character customising. For instance, you can have a strength oriented character "equip" a vision that uses healing spells.
NOTE: I know this is for the PS5 version, but if you buy the Switch 1 version instead, there are moments the game stutters, even in dock mode! Also I wish you can totally skip the Resonance cutscenes. You can only skip them once the CGI animation starts, and it lags in the Switch 1.
[THEMAN_AUS] I actually saw this game on someone Instagram and I was like I’ve never heard of this.
[Fuzor] Just read up on this. So this is a remaster of a mobile game? And it only has the 1st chapter of that game?
[Agret] 1st season of the game. It's a good storyline and 1st season ends at a decent spot.
It's not a remaster, most things are totally remade and it plays like Octopath Traveler rather than anything like the mobile game it's based on.
[RZJohn] Depending on where you live, delivery can be free.
[YoursTruly] Try the demo to see if it’s for you.
Spectacle over Substance.
Shallow nostalgia driven grab-fest that doesn’t deliver.
I found it to be very simplified, cringe-fest with a non existent meaningful story…
It’s a disconnected mess.
Nothing deep, nothing well-crafted and nothing well thought-out like the old school 2D FF.
Stinks of a garbage mobile phone FF 🤢🤮
[Agret] Keep playing, storyline is good. Veritas all have cool character designs and you get their back stories. Storyline is one of the best FF games.
The visions are nostalgia stuff but the storyline is it's own thing entirely. They don't have any past final fantasy characters in the actual storyline.
[wonderboy] How exactly do you get the $10 off newsletter code? I made a new account, signed up for the newsletter but never received it.
